Program cache keys now share a versioned, framed contract covering complete model content, semantic converter version, options/environment, I/O specialization and compiler/runtime/device compatibility. Ordinary TensorRT plans and portable flow exports use v3 keys. Previous v2 caches are preserved; the first request rebuilds or re-exports once, then reuses the result.

Targeted checks established field invalidation, rejection of incomplete contracts, byte-identical flow exports and zero warm rebuilds. TensorRT output is exact with the same plan; independent rebuilds differed by at most 1/255 on the test frame. No FPS improvement is claimed. Other native provider integrations remain separate.

See [the qualification report](https://github.com/Ta2b/mpv-AnimeJaNai-HDR/blob/release/docs/qualification/lot-13-program-contract-20261016.md). Platform assets appear as independent builds finish.
